description: synctex CLI 1.5 (TeX Live 2026, texlive/texlive:latest-full) answers for clicks on the centre of words (pdftotext -bbox) of a 4-file document (para-src: \input, \include, sub-folders, paragraphs of 6 source lines of unique pseudo-words), compiled like Folio does (latexmk -cd -synctex=1 in /compile). "first" marks the first word of a typeset line; "expected" is where the word is in the sources.
